'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Brazil]]
**[[Brazil]]'s [[Federal Senate (Brazil)|Federal Senate]] approves a [[Constitution of Brazil|constitutional]] [[Constitutional amendment|amendment]] that phases in [[Judiciary of Brazil|court]]-ordered [[Government debt|debt]] payments to fiscal target calculations beginning in 2027, initially counting 10% of the total and gradually reaching full inclusion over up to ten years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazils-congress-clears-new-fiscal-rule-court-ordered-debt-payments-2025-09-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 60 people are killed and dozens rescued after an overloaded boat carrying more than 100 passengers strikes a submerged [[tree stump]] and capsizes on the [[Niger River]] near [[Borgu Local Government Area|Borgu]], [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]], with search operations continuing for missing persons. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-rises-60-nigeria-boat-accident-officials-say-2025-09-03/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belgium–Palestine relations]], [[Belgium–Israel relations]], [[International recognition of Palestine]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Belgium)|Belgian foreign minister]] [[Maxime Prévot]] announces that [[Belgium]] will conditionally recognize a [[Palestine|Palestinian state]] at the [[Eightieth session of the United Nations General Assembly|upcoming United Nations General Assembly session]] upon the release of hostages and removal of [[Hamas]], and impose [[List of sanctions involving Israel|sanctions]] on [[Israel]], including bans on products from [[Israeli settlements]] and restrictions on certain [[Government procurement|public contracts]]. [https://www.reuters.com/en/belgium-recognise-palestinian-state-un-general-assembly-2025-09-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Catholic Church sexual abuse cases]]
**A [[Bolivia]]n [[Judiciary of Bolivia|court]] sentences two [[Spaniards|Spanish]] [[Jesuit]] [[Priesthood in the Catholic Church|priests]] to a year in prison for failing to report [[child sexual abuse]] by a fellow priest, whose posthumous diary revealed he abused at least 85 minors between 1972 and 2000. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-sentences-priests-concealing-decades-child-sex-abuse-2025-09-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Prosecution of Syrian civil war criminals]]
**[[Judiciary of France|French judges]] issue [[arrest warrant]]s for seven former senior [[Ba'athist Syria]]n officials, including former [[President of Syria|president]] [[Bashar al-Assad]], on charges of complicity in [[War crimes in the Syrian civil war|war crimes]] and [[crimes against humanity]] for a [[2012 Homs offensive|2012 rocket attack]] on a media center in [[Homs]] that killed journalists [[Marie Colvin]] and [[Rémi Ochlik]] and injured others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-seeks-arrest-assad-six-other-former-top-syrian-officials-over-2012-attack-2025-09-02/ (Reuters)]
*Five people are injured, including one critically and two seriously, in a [[mass stabbing]] attack at a hotel and a nearby street in [[Marseille]], [[France]]. The perpetrator, a 35-year-old Tunisian, is fatally shot by police. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/france/article/2025/09/02/french-police-kill-man-suspected-of-stabbing-five-people-in-marseille_6744975_7.html (''Le Monde'')]
*An [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[Judiciary of Argentina|court]] places the daughter of [[Nazi]] adviser [[Friedrich Kadgien]] and her husband under [[house arrest]] and accuses them of stealing the painting ''[[Portrait of a Lady (Contessa Colleoni)|Portrait of a Lady]]'', which had been missing since 1945. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-nazi-art-dutch-goudstikker-restitution-kadgien-0773fe94c60f5656bf218fb8c137fc25 (AP)]
